However, it was slightly lenient on the 'Body is compact and cobby' checkpoint. While the visible torso suggests this, the pose (lying down) obscures the topline and overall proportions, making a definitive 'present' verdict difficult. I will maintain 'present' but note the limitation. The Router correctly marked limb/tail/gait checkpoints as untestable due to occlusion/pose.
artifact_review: The Router identified background geometry issues (severity 1.5) and edge smudging (severity 1.0). The animal_pose_auditor reported a HIGH artifact risk (76% low-confidence keypoints), particularly in the limbs and ears. While the Reflector instructions say to treat low confidence as a weak signal for AI images, the combination of low confidence in the ears (which look visually acceptable but perhaps structurally ambiguous to the model) and the limbs (which are obscured) suggests potential structural ambiguity or 'melting' into the blanket that the Router underestimated. The topology mask is clean, suggesting no gross fragmentation. The perceptual auditor noted 'darken' which is likely just the B&W aesthetic. I will upgrade the severity of the limb/body interface ambiguity slightly due to the pose auditor's high risk flag, interpreting it as potential fusion/melting where the dog meets the blanket.

Structural alignment is good where visible.
